test_MultiHeadSelfAttention: test the MultiHeadSelfAttention class by passing a query tensor and verifying attention output values
test_MultiHeadAttentionWithCache_self_at: test MultiHeadAttentionWithCache for self-attention with past key-value cache and verify cached outputs are appended
test_MultiHeadAttentionWithCache_cross_a: test MultiHeadAttentionWithCache for cross-attention with separate query and key-value dimensions
test_MultiHeadAttentionWithCache_dropout: test MultiHeadAttentionWithCache with dropout enabled and verify attention output and cache behavior
test_MultiHeadAttentionWithCache_scripti: test that MultiHeadAttentionWithCache can be scripted with torch.jit.script and produces identical outputs
